apks.secondary: cameratest-secondary.apk (com.example.camerasecondary, CAMERA but no media permissions)

command_template: adb shell am instrument -w -r {-e key value ...} -e class {class} com.example.cameratest/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
case_command_translation: Case files write 'com.example.cameratest/.X'; run it as '-e class com.example.cameratest.X com.example.cameratest/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner'. Every X exists in the APK.
result_parsing: With -r, take the line 'INSTRUMENTATION_STATUS: harness_json=<json>'. Without -r, the same JSON is printed as its own line (status 'stream'). Exactly one JSON per operation.

variables_from_CapabilityTest.TELEPHOTO_CAMERA_ID: physicalCameras[] (or BACK camera) with equivalentFocalMm >= 1.8 x primary
variables_from_CapabilityTest.ULTRAWIDE_CAMERA_ID: physicalCameras[] (or BACK camera) with equivalentFocalMm <= 0.8 x primary
variables_from_CapabilityTest.SUPPORTED_HDR_MODE / PORTRAIT / NIGHT su: cameras[].extensions or cameras[].sceneModes; hlg10 for HDR video

cam_fun_005.name: Supported Photo Resolution Validation
cam_fun_005.notes: resolutions is a JSON array string, e.g. ["4000x3000","1920x1080"]

cam_fun_007.name: Autofocus Operation
cam_fun_007.manual: Place ${FOCUS_TEST_TARGET} in front of the camera; judge sharpness from the saved image if required.

cam_fun_008.name: Tap-to-Focus Operation
cam_fun_008.manual: Place ${FOCUS_TEST_TARGET} at the focus point. x / y are 0..1 in sensor orientation.

cam_fun_009.name: Flash ON Operation
cam_fun_009.manual: Tester may visually confirm the flash fired; harness reports FLASH_STATE.

cam_fun_011.name: Flash Auto Operation
cam_fun_011.manual: Set ambient light to ${AMBIENT_LIGHT_LUX} lux; flash_fired should equal flash_required.

cam_fun_013.name: Optical Zoom and Telephoto Lens Switching
cam_fun_013.notes: Alternatively pass target_camera=${TELEPHOTO_CAMERA_ID}. Telephoto switching may need adequate light and subject distance.

cam_fun_018.name: HDR Photo and Video Operation
cam_fun_018.manual: Use a high-contrast ${HDR_TEST_SCENE}. capture_type=video records HLG10 HEVC.

cam_fun_019.name: Portrait Mode Operation
cam_fun_019.manual: Subject at ${PORTRAIT_SUBJECT_DISTANCE}; background blur is judged from the saved image.

cam_sec_001.name: Camera Permission Grant Validation
host_pre: adb shell pm revoke com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_001.notes: Harness verifies denial, grants CAMERA itself via UiAutomation, then verifies access.

cam_sec_002.name: Camera Permission Denial Enforcement
host_pre: adb shell pm revoke com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
host_post: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

cam_sec_003.name: Camera Permission Revocation Enforcement
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

host: adb shell pm revoke com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

host_post: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

cam_sec_004.name: One-Time Camera Permission Behavior
host_pre: adb shell pm revoke com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
adb shell pm clear-permission-flags com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA user-set user-fixed

phases.manual: Tester taps 'Only this time' in the permission dialog.

host_post: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

cam_sec_005.name: While-in-Use Camera Permission Enforcement
cam_sec_005.case_command: adb shell am instrument -w -e camera_id ${REAR_PRIMARY_CAMERA_ID} -e background_observation_sec ${BACKGROUND_OBSERVATION_SEC} com.example.cameratest/.WhileInUsePermissionSecurityTest
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_005.notes: BLOCKED_PRECONDITION if instrumentation keeps the process foreground.

cam_sec_006.name: Background Camera Access Restriction
cam_sec_006.case_command: adb shell am instrument -w -e camera_id ${REAR_PRIMARY_CAMERA_ID} -e observation_sec ${BACKGROUND_OBSERVATION_SEC} com.example.cameratest/.BackgroundCameraRestrictionTest
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_006.notes: BLOCKED_PRECONDITION if instrumentation keeps the process foreground.

cam_sec_007.name: Camera Privacy Indicator Validation
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_007.manual: Tester confirms the privacy indicator; re-run with -e indicator_confirmed true if not auto-detected.

cam_sec_008.name: Camera Privacy Toggle Blocking Validation
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_008.manual: Enable the camera privacy toggle (Quick Settings), or pass -e toggle_via_shell true where 'cmd sensor_privacy' is permitted.

cam_sec_009.name: Camera Access After Privacy Toggle Restoration
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
cam_sec_009.manual: Disable the camera privacy toggle, or pass -e toggle_via_shell true.

cam_sec_011.name: Camera Access After App Permission Reset
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

host: adb shell pm revoke com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

cam_sec_012.name: Camera Access After App Data Reset
host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA
host_post: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

host_pre: adb shell pm grant com.example.cameratest android.permission.CAMERA

cam_sec_018.name: Camera Resource Isolation Between Applications
cam_sec_018.case_command: adb shell am instrument -w -e primary_package ${CAMERA_TEST_PACKAGE} -e secondary_package ${SECONDARY_TEST_PACKAGE} com.example.cameratest/.CameraResourceIsolationSecurityTest
